name: legal-terminus-ios
description: Legal Terminus iPhone app: a Capacitor shell around the Portal (Portal/dist-mobile). QA and production builds come from one switch, LT_APP_ENV.

scripts.build:web: node ../MobileShared/scripts/app-env.mjs && cd ../Portal && npm run build:mobile && cd ../iOSApp && node ../MobileShared/scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.run:app: npm run sync && cap run ios
